sources.supports: Ethos-N78 scalable 1-10 TOP/s; mobile/edge NPU class reference, not a specific phone.
8x8 MAC/cycle, INT8/INT16, embedded SRAM 384 KB-4 MB. Our separate 8 MiB scratchpad is NOT claimed as Ethos-N78 SRAM.
8533 MT/s x64 parts imply 68.264 GB/s theoretical package bandwidth. Chosen 64 GB/s is an abstract available-bandwidth assumption, not a measured NPU allocation.

limitations: 20/35 TOPS are user-selected compute-scale comparisons, not calibrated named SoCs.
1 MAC = 2 operations; TOPS denotes dense integer operations, not floating-point FLOPS or sparse effective TOPS.
Matrix utilization stays at the previous ideal value 1.0; no speed-target fitting.
Vector throughput, 0.3 W static power, 100 pJ/byte DRAM energy, and 256 GB/s scratchpad bus are uncalibrated assumptions.
Same electronic and memory profile is used by D0 and all hybrid modes. Photonic core parameters do not change.
NPU operator support, CPU fallback, real driver/runtime, graph fusion, DRAM burst merging, thermal throttling, and transient writing power are not modeled.
Historical engine fields hbm and electronic_peak_flops are compatibility aliases for external-DRAM events and effective operations/s. Canonical units are recorded separately.
